# レシピの網羅(族・課題・型の繋がり・GPU 経路)

レシピ = 型で繋がる op の組み合わせ例。正本は `recipes.py`(Studio の見本 25 本)と `fullseye/recipebook/`(網羅用 218 本)。全部を `tests/test_recipebook.py` が合成入力 2 種で実際に走らせ、型の繋がり・出力が定数でないこと・入力に応じて動くこと・真値の門(ある物)を確かめる。
MCP の検索(`fullseye_find_ops`)は runner = mcp(MCP の pipeline でそのまま走る物)だけを返す。

課題の分類: 3d 30, analysis 23, inspection 53, measurement 63, optics 8, preprocess 38, sensing 14, simulation 9, visualization 5

HALCON の章: 1D Measuring 7, 2D Metrology 5, 3D Matching 5, 3D Object Model 18, 3D Reconstruction 11, Calibration 4, Color 8, Features 2, Filters 10, Frequency 1, Identification 1, Inspection 4, Matching 5, Morphology 3, OCR 3, Regions 17, Restoration 2, Segmentation 8, Texture 3, Transformations 6, XLD 6

GPU の切り替わり = 隣り合う 2 段で、片方だけが pipeline 文脈の GPU 経路(`gpu_route.route(op, "pipeline")`)を持つ箇所の数(CPU と GPU の間の受け渡し 1 回)。snapshot に無い op を含むレシピは未計測。

## 足りない op(レシピを組もうとして無かった物)

| 族 | 欲しい物 | 理由 |
|---|---|---|
| 2d | circle fit to an XLD contour that returns (row, col, radius) — HALCON fit_circle_contour_xld | hx_fit_circle_contour returns only the RMS residual and hx_smallest_circle_xld a centroid-centred enclosing radius divided by max(H, W); the radius of a round part had to be read from elliptic_axis_xld (Ra = Rb) instead |
| 2d | watershed that returns the basins (one region / label per object) — HALCON watersheds 'Basins' | watersheds, pouring, xcv_watershed_markers and sg_watershed_gradient return only the dam lines; counting their components gives 1-4 for 4 / 6 touching disks, so splitting touching parts stops at the marker step (distance transform + h-maxima) and the split parts cannot be measured one by one |
| 2d | dominant spatial frequency / period of an image as a feature (strongest non-DC FFT peak: cycles/px and angle) | fft_image / power_real / power_ln return spectrum images; the max-projection profile's argmax lands on the DC column and tb_find_peaks returns ~30 noise peaks, so no chain reads the grating period from the spectrum (the texture period recipe goes through zero crossings of a profile instead) |
| 2d | bar-code / 2-D code decoding (symbology + data string) — HALCON find_bar_code / find_data_code_2d | decode_barcode only counts dark bars on the centre scan line; no op returns the encoded data |
| 2d | OCR character classification (HALCON do_ocr_single_class_mlp / read text) | the 2-D family can segment glyphs (hx_char_threshold, sk_sauvola) but nothing classifies them |
| 2d | polar unwrap about a given centre and radius range — HALCON polar_trans_image_ext with Row/Column/Radius | polar_trans_image(_ext) always use the image centre and min(H, W)/2; an off-centre ring / bore cannot be unwrapped after locating it with area_center (the ring recipe needs the ring at the image centre) |
| text | take the SWT field (matrix) out of swt_map's table, or a text_candidates that accepts swt_map's dict | swt_map -> table and text_candidates(matrix) do not connect; the detector pipeline swt -> candidates -> lines cannot be chained |
| vx | split vx_sobel3x3's {gx, gy} table into two S16 images (or a vx_sobel_magnitude) | vx_magnitude / vx_phase take two image2d, vx_sobel3x3 returns one table: the OpenVX gradient graph Sobel -> Magnitude -> NonMax cannot be chained |
| roughness | dominant wavelength (peak) of surface_psd's (frequency, PSD) pairs | feed-mark wavelength from an areal PSD needs an argmax-to-frequency read; no op converts the pairs to a scalar |
| segmentation | a mask argument (or a masked variant) for watersheds_marker | the flood assigns background pixels to the nearest marker, so region areas after a watershed split are wrong unless the mask is applied by another op (blob_split does that, but only with distance-map seeds) |
| 3d | PPF / surface-based matching: find a CAD model's 6-DoF pose in a scene cloud (HALCON find_surface_model) | no point-pair-feature or surface-model matching op exists in OP_GRAPH or docs/ops (only ICP / GICP / FPFH / SHOT / spin registration) |
| 3d | threshold a grey voxel volume to a binary voxel volume (voxel -> voxel) | no explicit volume threshold op; vol_label thresholds implicitly at 0.5 (fixed), and region_props / label_components binarise with astype(bool) (every nonzero voxel is foreground) |
| 3d | pose (R, t) -> 4x4 transform converter | rotation_translation_error / registration_recall take 4x4 matrices while dlt_pose / ICP / FPFH return (R, t) tuples; pose_error takes R and t as four separate arguments, so no pose-sorted chain can end in a pose-accuracy stage |
| reprconv | keypoints (row, col) <-> (u = col, v = row) swap | the keypoints sort carries both conventions (calib.project_3d_point returns (row, col); pnp3d.dlt_pose / pnp_ransac expect (u, v)) and no op converts between them |
| acoustics | TDOA (s) + microphone spacing -> source bearing angle (deg) | gcc_delay returns a delay; no op turns delay into a direction of arrival for a mic pair / array |
| piv | a pair generator whose ledger form returns both frames (or seq<image> of 2) | fs.ledger.piv_synth_pair keeps only frame a (declared image), so a pair cannot start a chain; piv_synth_sequence -> piv_ensemble_correlate works, piv_cross_correlate needs a sample-built pair |
| oned | spectrum peak picker: pairs (freqs, magnitude) -> measurement (peak frequency in Hz, sub-bin interpolated) | spectrum returns the typed pairs (freqs, /rfft/) but every peak op (find_peaks, peak_subbin) takes a signal; the FFT-peak chain spectrum -> peak cannot be typed, so the recipe reads peak_freq from signal_features instead (bin-quantised, no sub-bin refinement). |
| drive | table field selector (table -> image / signal / scalar, by key) | dict-returning drive ops cannot feed their natural consumers: flow_from_depth_motion -> {u, v} cannot reach ttc_from_flow(u: image, v: image) or foe_from_flow; label_extent -> {width} cannot reach ttc_from_scale(w0, w1). A generic typed 'get field' op would close all of these. |

## 組もうとして落とした鎖(op の不具合・宣言の嘘・入力が作れない等)

| 族 | 鎖 | op | 原因 | 内容 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2d | Measure — orientation of a bar from its sub-pixel outline (orientation_xld) | orientation_xld | doc_mismatch | returns 0.389 (70.0 deg) for a bar that orientation_region measures at 19.9 deg on the same scene (0.250 = 45 deg agrees only because 45 = 90 - 45) |
| 2d | Measure — equivalent-ellipse angle Phi of a bar (elliptic_axis) | elliptic_axis | doc_mismatch | Phi = -0.348 rad for a bar turned +20 deg counter-clockwise on screen, while orientation_region on the same region gives +19.9 deg; the note says Phi is counter-clockwise from the column axis (elliptic_axis_xld shows the same sign: -0.3505) |
| 2d | Inspect — count circular holes with the Hough circle transform (no pre-smoothing) | cv_hough_circles | doc_mismatch | returns 0.0 on blobs_image (3 disks r 6-8) and on disk_image (r 18) with noise sigma 0.02; cv2.HoughCircles called directly also returns None; after gaussian a=0.5 it counts 3 / 4 correctly |
| 2d | Inspect — split touching parts with a marker-controlled watershed | xcv_watershed_markers | type_gap | count_obj of its output = 3 / 4 for 4 / 6 touching disks (it returns the dam lines, not basins) |
| 2d | Measure — perimeter of a round part from sub-pixel edges | edges_sub_pix | doc_mismatch | gaussian -> edges_sub_pix -> length_xld = 2508 px for a disk of circumference 113 px (4237 vs 151): the edge points of one contour are not ordered along the curve, so length_xld / circularity_xld sum raster jumps; threshold_sub_pix (ordered |
| 2d | Inspect — length of a scratch from its line contour (lines_gauss) | lines_gauss | doc_mismatch | lines_gauss -> length_xld = 117 / 177 px for 40 / 60 px scratches (one contour of the thresholded ridge band's pixels, not a centre line) |
| text | Inspect — group character candidates into text lines | text_lines | doc_mismatch | text_candidates (out=table) -> text_lines (in=table): TypeError: int() argument must be a string, a bytes-like object or a real number, not 'dict' — it needs the (N, 4) boxes array |
| text | Inspect — detect text: SWT then character candidates | text_candidates | type_gap | swt_map returns table {swt, edges, ...}; text_candidates takes matrix (the swt field) |
| vx | Inspect — OpenVX gradient magnitude | vx_magnitude | type_gap | vx_sobel3x3 returns table {gx, gy, valid}; vx_magnitude needs two image2d |
| 3d | 3D — object pose from known 3-D points and their image (PnP) | project_3d_point -> dlt_pose | type_gap | no exception; project_3d_point gives (row, col), dlt_pose reads (u, v) -> mirrored pose t = (-0.565, 0.61, 3.21) instead of (0.1, -0.05, 3.0) |
| reprconv | Measure — rotation angle of a part from matched 2-D points | vector_to_rigid -> matrix_to_angle | type_gap | no exception; vector_to_rigid returns a 2-D homogeneous 3x3 [[c,-s,tx],[s,c,ty],[0,0,1]] while matrix_to_angle reads a rotation in axes (1, 2) (atan2(R[2,1], R[1,1])) -> 0.0 deg for a 20 deg rotation; matrix_to_rot_scale raises 'matrix: mus |
| geocam | Sense — sun elevation at a site over a day | sun_position | doc_mismatch | OP_GRAPH declares one input (signal) + kw lon_deg, unix_times, but the signature is (lat_deg, lon_deg, unix_times): the signal lands in lat_deg -> TypeError: only 0-dimensional arrays can be converted to Python scalars |
| 3d | 3D — pose accuracy of a registration against ground truth | pose_error / rotation_translation_error | doc_mismatch | pose_error is declared [pose, pose] but takes (R_est, t_est, R_gt, t_gt); rotation_translation_error needs 4x4 matrices, which no pose-producing op returns |
| piv | piv_synth_pair -> piv_cross_correlate | piv_synth_pair | type_gap | fs.ledger.piv_synth_pair returns only frame a (64, 64); frame b and the truth are dropped, so piv_cross_correlate(a, b) has no b in the chain |
| lightfield | lf_synthesize -> lf_epi_slope -> lf_disparity_to_depth | lf_epi_slope | op_bug | runs, but the structure-tensor EPI slope reads -1.38 for a true -1.5 px/view (8 % bias; 0.995 for 1.0), so the depth gate fails at 2 %; lf_depth_from_focus is used instead |
| optics | thick_lens -> paraxial_trace | thick_lens | type_gap | paraxial_trace: expected the dict returned by lens_system(); thick_lens returns its own EFL table |
| flyvision | matrix -> fly_lamina_filter -> fly_t4t5_field(three_arm) | fly_t4t5_field | type_gap | ValueError movie has a negative entry; the default model needs one ON/OFF half (onoff[:, :n]) which a chain cannot slice — used model='hr' instead |
| drive | Measure — RSS minimum safe following distance (rss_params -> rss_longitudinal_same) | rss_longitudinal_same | declaration_lie | TypeError: rss_longitudinal_same() missing 2 required positional arguments: 'v_front' and 'p' — OP_GRAPH inputs=['table'] binds the first positional slot, which is v_rear (a float); parameter_schema omits v_rear. Same pattern for rss_longit |
| drive | Sense — TTC from optical flow (flow_from_depth_motion -> ttc_from_flow) | ttc_from_flow | type_gap | flow_from_depth_motion outputs table {u, v, valid, depth1}; ttc_from_flow inputs ['image', 'image'] — no op selects a table field as an image. Via the ledger too: fs.ledger.ttc_from_flow(flow_table, dt=0.1) -> TypeError: missing 1 required  |
| drive | Sense — TTC from apparent size growth (label_extent -> ttc_from_scale) | ttc_from_scale | type_gap | label_extent outputs table {width, height, ...}; ttc_from_scale is declared a generator (inputs []) taking w0, w1 as scalar keywords. Via the ledger: fs.ledger.ttc_from_scale(extent_table, dt=0.1) -> TypeError: missing 1 required positional |
| oned | Sense — FFT peak frequency (spectrum -> find_peaks -> peak_subbin) | find_peaks | type_gap | spectrum outputs pairs (freqs, magnitude); find_peaks / peak_subbin input 'signal' — type cut at stage 2. Via the ledger: fs.ledger.find_peaks(spectrum(...)) -> ValueError: expected a 1-D signal ..., got shape (129, 2) |
